overview_description.description:
The Omniyat Group is a privately held real estate development and service-related group. The company creates living canvases of residential, commercial, hospitality, and retail spaces. It undertakes investment, development, and asset management across a broad spectrum of property assets, providing sustained value and tangible, measurable benefits to all stakeholders involved, including shareholders, buyers, and the community.

Omniyat was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Dubai, United Arab Emirates.
